revision_reason: Whole-item revisions address the two REVISE decisions recorded in PR #479. Options now match the categories asked by their stems.

governance.note: The four unchanged items retain their prior technical pass decisions; this packet does not itself validate or approve the two revised items.

questions.question: Which alternator component converts alternating current into direct current for the vehicle electrical system?
questions.explanation: An automotive alternator generates alternating current and uses diode rectification to provide direct current.

questions.question: Which component is primarily responsible for generating electric energy in a modern vehicle?
questions.explanation: Alternators are identified as the primary source of electric energy within a vehicle.

questions.question: An automotive alternator typically consists of which of the following components?

options.A: Rotor, stator, diode rectifier, and voltage regulator

questions.explanation: The alternator is described as a synchronous AC generator with a rotor, stator, diode rectifier, and voltage regulator.

questions.question: The cited description assigns two different functions to an automotive alternator. Which option matches each process to its function?

options.A: Diode rectification converts AC to DC; pulse-width modulation controls voltage.
options.B: Pulse-width modulation converts AC to DC; diode rectification controls voltage.
options.C: Diode rectification generates AC; pulse-width modulation converts AC to DC.
options.D: Pulse-width modulation generates AC; diode rectification controls rotor speed.

questions.explanation: The source describes DC diode rectification and pulse-width modulation voltage control as separate processes. Rectification provides DC from AC, while PWM is the voltage-control method.

questions.question: What is the approximate efficiency of a typical automotive alternator?
questions.explanation: The cited evidence states that an automotive alternator has an efficiency of about 55%.

questions.question: According to the cited description, how is an automotive alternator classified as a generator before its output is rectified?
questions.explanation: The source classifies the alternator as a synchronous AC generator and separately describes diode rectification of its output to DC.
